scope: The principal cliff-top Penglai Pavilion and its immediately attached terrace and circulation, in the configuration illustrated in the 1925 volume.

originalQuallaReview.disposition: Excluded from geometry. This CC0 photograph depicts a museum diorama. The rights holder for the diorama itself was not established.

periodPhoto.title: Shantung
periodPhoto.observations: Printed page 72, PDF page 77, is labeled 蓬萊閣 and shows the pavilion and stone terraces on Danya Hill. The colophon on PDF page 100 explicitly dates this edition and names the publisher. The plate establishes the massing and limits of recognizable architectural details.

constructionSources.fact: Shandong heritage records a 14.8 m by 9.85 m plan, double eaves, 16 perimeter columns, 12 inner posts and 4 central posts, gray tiles and a front rail.
Penglai county record gives a 13.75 m by 8.55 m upper level, 16 gallery columns, railings and east, north and west screens.
Yantai register places the 15 m high, two-storey wooden structure on top of Danya Hill facing south.

mappedControl.placementBasis: Use the pavilion identity and cliff terrain plus the measured plan dimensions. Record any approximate anchoring and terrace interpretation.
